generation.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create a NEW pixel-art game sprite sheet, using reference image 1 ONLY for Lia's fictional identity, face, long reddish blond curly hair and game pixel-art style. Reference image 2 ONLY illustrates traveling equipment, its wrong atlas arrangement MUST NOT be copied.
Subject: Lia, an independent novel character, never resemblance to film actresses. Young woman with long reddish blond curls held back with a plain narrow hair band, simple white linen blouse, long plain brown skirt, worn leather shoes, small brown journey satchel with rolled wool blanket. NO book in her hands or under her arm, both hands free. NO green cloak in this sheet.
EXACT LAYOUT: one square transparent sprite sheet. EXACTLY FOUR ROWS AND FOUR COLUMNS, 16 separate whole-body sprites. Uniform grid. Row 1 FOUR SOUTH/front-facing walk phases. Row 2 FOUR WEST/left-facing walk phases. Row 3 FOUR EAST/right-facing walk phases. Row 4 FOUR NORTH/back-facing walk phases. Never omit north or replace any row with a costume. Every direction four distinct walking leg positions; same identity and outfit in all 16. No text, labels, borders, grass, scenery or cast shadows. Full body with clean empty space around each sprite; enough gutter to crop each of sixteen uniform cells. True transparent background. Crisp chunky low-resolution pixel-art suitable for downsize to roughly 37 pixels tall. Keep head/body proportions, copper curly hair and costume colors matching reference 1.
